controlled_propositions.proposition: RICPE audited 2023 accounts identify Series F — Hotel MYND Yaiza — 253 shares, total issue EUR 1,598,849.32.
RICPE audited 2023 accounts identify Series G — MYND Yaiza Employment Creation — 785 shares, total issue EUR 4,974,853.78.
The controlled accounting record reports Canary Islands Government idoneidad on 1 December 2022, reform financing in 2022 and hotel opening after reform/transformation on 16 December 2022.

The Canary Islands Council of Government agenda of 1 December 2022 records approval at F.O.D. 25 of a draft decree declaring the idoneidad of the financial instruments referred to in an application by RIC Private Equity Investment Partners, S.C.R., S.A.

Resolution 28/2026 of 10 August 2026 refused the 7 July Canary Islands access request in full and identifies Decree 224/2022, administrative file 02/2022 and the AEAT binding report of 17 November 2022 as procedural antecedents.
An appeal against Resolution 28/2026 was filed with the Canary Islands Transparency Commissioner on 11 August 2026 under REGAGE26e00072591992, internal file 12/2026-0710092416.

Direct AEAT access request REGAGE26e00062944142 was presented on 7 July 2026; the Registro Electrónico General later confirmed processing by the Registro Central de la AEAT from 8 July 2026 at 09:51:37.

Connected Gmail audit through 18 August 2026 located no substantive AEAT transparency decision and no email notice tied to that REGAGE of an Article 20 extension or Article 19 third-party suspension; official portals must still be checked before treating the route as final administrative silence.

central_questions: Did Decree 224/2022 and the AEAT binding report of 17 November 2022 cover Series F, Series G, or both?
Did a second, amended, supplementary or parallel idoneidad/report exist?
What exact works, invoices, outstanding liabilities, prior eligible expenditure, permitted reimbursement or bridge financing did the EUR 1,598,849.32 Series F participatory financing fund?
How were Series F/G reconciled with any other public aid, incentives, employment commitments or financing layers?
